Questions

Pricing questions

Is BackDown free?

The core will be free forever and source-available: backup, restore, dedup, the command line and the local web UI. The paid tiers add what BackDown knows about your data: recognition, provenance, fleet and forensic features.

What does "per machine" mean?

One seat covers one computer running BackDown, however many drives or terabytes it looks at. You're never charged for the amount of data.

Do I need an account?

No. The local edition needs no account and makes no network requests. A licence is a signed key you add once; BackDown checks it offline.

Will these prices change?

They're planned launch prices in US dollars and may change before release. Early-access members hear first.

Are taxes included?

No. Sales tax or VAT is added at checkout, based on your billing address. Businesses can enter a tax ID.

Hear when 1.0 is out.
